extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH grant biographical sketches and research support sections
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and template examples for preparing NIH-style biographical sketches and Research Support sections (Personal Statement, Education/Training, Contributions to Science, Ongoing/Completed Research Support, patents/publications) for key personnel on grant applications. Includes page limits, required fields, and examples of acceptable content and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall biographical sketch format and page limit (five pages)
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified format for each person and keep the total length at or below the stated page limit (example shows a five-page limit for one form of the biosketch). Examples of filled sections (Personal Statement, Positions, Contributions, Research Support) are provided as models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall biographical sketch format and page limit (four pages)
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some versions/templates on the page specify a four-page maximum for the biosketch; authors must obey the specific page-limit instruction printed on the form they are using.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification fields (name, position title, eRA Commons username)
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME: [full name]  POSITION TITLE: [title]  eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, current position title, and eRA Commons username (or other credential) as part of the header information on the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table and required columns
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)  INSTITUTION AND LOCATION  DEGREE (if applicable)  Completion Date MM/YYYY  FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an education/training table beginning with the baccalaureate, including postdoctoral/residency training as applicable. Supply institution/location, degree (if applicable), completion date (use the date format indicated, e.g., MM/YYYY or MM/YY as shown in different templates), and field of study. Add or remove rows as needed to reflect training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (A. Personal Statement)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement — a concise statement describing the individual's research focus, recent work, and how their expertise is relevant to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Personal Statement to summarize research in the laboratory/group, emphasize principal accomplishments and areas of expertise, and explicitly state the relevance of those skills and recent work to the proposed project's aims and methods. Provide concrete examples of recent focus and methods if helpful (the page contains multiple model Personal Statements demonstrating length and content).

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Employment (B. Positions and Employment / Positions and Honors)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors / Positions and Employment — chronological listing of positions held (with dates) and honors received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List academic and professional positions in chronological order with dates. Include notable honors and awards in a separate subsection. Examples on the page show how to format multi-decade careers and honors lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science (C. Contributions to Science)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contributions to Science — numbered, titled descriptions of the individual's major scientific contributions, each followed by representative citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution, provide a short narrative describing the contribution and then list representative publications (with PMCID/PMID where available). The examples show grouping of related publications under each numbered contribution and inclusion of citation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published work (MyBibliography link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/myncbi/browse/collection/…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link (e.g., MyBibliography) or other pointer to the author's complete publication record in addition to selected representative citations in the Contributions to Science section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support section content and formatting (ongoing and completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — Ongoing Research Support and Completed Research Support entries must include grant number, agency, dates, title, purpose, and role (e.g., PI, co-investigator).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each grant or contract, list the grant identifier (e.g., R01, R21, SBIR numbers), funding agency, project dates, project title, a brief statement of the purpose/goals, and the individual's role on the project. Distinguish ongoing versus completed support. Examples on the page illustrate phrasing for purpose statements and role assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of overlap in research support
rubrics_metrics.description: No overlap (or less than 10% in science, none in budget)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When listing research support, explicitly state whether there is scientific or budgetary overlap between the listed projects and the project under review. If overlap exists, quantify or describe it (the page shows the practice of declaring 'No overlap (or less than 10% in science, none in budget)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents and intellectual property entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Patents — list title, inventors, publication date, and application number (example: Drug Release from a Polymer-Controlled Local Antibiotic Delivery System Using a Degradable Bone Graft; Inventors: ... Publication date: 2013/2/5; Application number: 13/759,904).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include patents (issued or pending) relevant to the investigator's work, with inventor names, publication/issue dates, and application/serial numbers to document translational activity and IP holdings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation formatting and inclusion of PMCID/PMID
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected publications are presented with full citation details and, where available, PMCID or PMID (e.g., 'PMCID: PMC2873530' or 'PMID: 26252731').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full citation details for representative publications and include PMCID/PMID when available to facilitate access and compliance with public access policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Experience and Professional Memberships
rubrics_metrics.description: List other experience and professional memberships (example: 'Other Experience and Professional Memberships' followed by entries and dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include significant professional memberships, visiting appointments, fellowships, and other non-positional experiences that support the individual's qualifications for the proposed work.
